label_provenance: Codex agent source audit; not independent human labels. Full copied467-chunk corpus literal-search audit plus originalPDF page/unit/header inspection. No judge model or answer-page-only inference.
metric_definition: Per-question fraction of required evidencegroups fully supported by at leastone verified sourcebundle among selectedchunks; macro-average over verified answerable questions. All pieces in a bundle required; alternatives are OR. Fullsupport is separate. Whitespace equivalence only; period/currency/units required for financialfacts.
limitations: Reviewed bundles are conservative source support labels, not an exhaustive semantic annotation of everypossible paraphrase or arithmetic path.
Some table alternatives require a header chunk and row chunk; a matchingpage or numeric token alone never suffices.
Unknown question/corpusidentity or changedtext requires review; no positive relevance is inferred from pageidentity.
Phase2 rawgenerated quotes forfailedvalidation were notsaved; exact historicalfailurecause cannot be reconstructed from finalabstention alone.
